text:
```yaml
name: SBOM Generation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - 'yarn.lock'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'bun.lockb'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'package.json'
      - 'package-lock.json'
      - 'yarn.lock'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'bun.lockb'

jobs:
  sbom:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Generate SBOM
        uses: anchore/sbom-action@v0
        with:
          path: .
          format: cyclonedx
          output-file: sbom.xml
          upload-artifact: true
          upload-artifact-retention: 90
          artifact-name: sbom
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
